reason: I have never heard of AITechnician and nobody I know in the trade uses it. Even with the free month, I am not putting my customers' WhatsApp and my AMC list into an app from a company I can't vouch for.
objection: Who is behind this and will they still be around next year? If they shut down after I have moved my team and my AMC reminders onto it, I am the one left explaining to customers.
would_change_my_mind: A fellow service company owner or my distributor telling me they have used it with their technicians for a few months and it actually works.
